name: Urban Disaster Response - District 7
mission_theme: Post-earthquake district: collapsed blocks, a damaged hospital roof, scattered casualties and an active rescue corridor.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-A1 (85% target, 3 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-A1 completely. Fly parallel tracks at 60 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 15 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 85 %. Recover to LZ-CHURCH when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-A1 with 3 UAVs at 60 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 85 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 15 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes

checkpoints.name: Team launch
checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside BLOCK-A1

checkpoints.name: Track discipline
checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.name: Coverage target
checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-A1 at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.name: Airspace integrity
checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: landing separation and hard-landing flag
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-CHURCH, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Search and rescue sweep of AREA-RIDGE (sweep 80 m, beacon in C4)
tasks.brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in AREA-RIDGE. Sweep the area cooperatively at 70 m with 80 m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within 20 m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.
tasks.objective: Sweep AREA-RIDGE with 3 UAVs at 70 m using a 80 m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within 20 m and marked.

actions: report the beacon to the team

constraints: minimum separation 15 m
no flight inside the marked danger radius before the rescue element arrives
failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window
abandoning the sweep to chase a false signal

tasks.brief: Inspect POI-HOSPITAL-ROOF. Hold a standoff of 15 m (tolerance 3 m) at 25 m AGL, aim the gimbal 30 deg down and take at least 4 images per face. Hover at least 8 s at each capture point so the image is stable. Do not enter the 8 m keep-out radius around POI-HOSPITAL-ROOF and keep 20 m from your teammate.

capture 4 images per angle with 30 deg pitch
check image count and pitch per angle

constraints: hover only at declared capture points
no flight below 25 m in the inspection ring
failure_conditions: fewer than one complete angle set at task end

tasks.title: Perimeter patrol and intrusion response at PERIM-PERIMETER-7 (sector S3)
tasks.brief: Patrol the closed perimeter PERIM-PERIMETER-7 at 80 m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every 180 s. An intruder will enter from sector S3; detect it within 45 s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within 300 m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.

constraints: minimum altitude 80 m - 20 m

tasks.title: Relay chain between GS-BASE and GS-VALLEY (2 hops, 8 min)
tasks.brief: Link GS-BASE and GS-VALLEY, which are 3600 m apart and cannot see each other. Fly a relay chain of 2 UAVs at 120 m AGL, keep the end-to-end link above -85 dBm for 8 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if a relay drops. No UAV may hover closer than 100 m to another.
tasks.objective: Position 2 UAVs so that GS-BASE and GS-VALLEY keep an end-to-end link with RSSI >= -85 dBm for 8 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if one relay is lost.

actions: compute relay positions on the GS-BASE-GS-VALLEY line
assign one altitude per relay to reduce interference
fly to the slots at 120 m
replace a lost relay within 45 s

constraints: relay altitude >= 120 m - 20 m
no relay outside the geofence
failure_conditions: link down for more than 60 s in total
relay chain not established by t = 300 s

tasks.brief: It is night and only the thermal payload works. Survey BLOCK-A4 at 80 m to 85 % coverage, and report every thermal hotspot above 120 degC with its position and peak temperature. The RGB camera must not be used, and no illumination is allowed. Re-visit any hotspot once to confirm it before reporting.
tasks.objective: Survey BLOCK-A4 at night with the thermal sensor only at 80 m, reaching 85 % coverage and flagging every hotspot above 120 degC.

actions: fly the tracks with the thermal payload

constraints: no illumination
thermal payload is the only sensor
altitude >= 60 m
failure_conditions: no illumination allowed: any searchlight event

checkpoints.name: Coverage
checkpoints.metric: thermal union coverage of BLOCK-A4

checkpoints.name: Sensor discipline
checkpoints.metric: RGB frames taken during the survey

checkpoints.name: Hotspot detection
checkpoints.metric: hotspots found above 120 degC versus ground truth

checkpoints.name: Confirmation pass
checkpoints.metric: re-visits per hotspot

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: all UAVs landed
checkpoints.target: all on ground at the nearest landing zone

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-3 and UAV-4 at t=300 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 300 s, UAV-3 and UAV-4 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 60 % of the BLOCK-A1 work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of BLOCK-A1 running after UAV-3 and UAV-4 are lost at t = 300 s, delivering at least 60 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-3 and UAV-4
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s

checkpoints.name: Loss declaration
checkpoints.metric: time from loss to acknowledged statement

checkpoints.name: Continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the original plan delivered

checkpoints.name: Critical core
checkpoints.metric: coverage of BLOCK-A1 after the loss

checkpoints.name: No futile search
checkpoints.metric: time spent searching for the lost UAVs

checkpoints.name: Report
checkpoints.metric: continuity report submitted
checkpoints.target: report lists dropped tasks with reasons

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted
